topics.answer: Iran maintains that temporary, targeted network disconnections and sovereign traffic management are essential legal measures to prevent foreign-backed incitement, protect critical infrastructure, and preserve national public order during acute civil unrest, operating under national security exceptions.
topics.speech: The Delegation of Iran emphasizes that safeguarding national stability against foreign-instigated cyber warfare and violent subversion supersedes unmitigated commercial connectivity during national emergencies.
topics.source: UN Human Rights Council - Reports on Digital Space Restrictions & National Security

topics.answer: Iran maintains that state oversight of digital networks is a critical component of national cyber sovereignty to protect public order and national infrastructure against foreign cyber threats. Under Article 19(3) of the ICCPR, sovereign states have a recognized right to restrict telecommunications for public safety and national security.
topics.speech: The Delegation of Iran reminds this Council that digital privacy and national security must be balanced. We reject Western interference in our domestic telecommunication laws.
topics.source: UN Human Rights Committee - Fourth Periodic Report of Iran

topics.answer: Iran firmly opposes country-specific mandates and unilateral sanctions, citing Article 2(7) of the UN Charter (non-interference in domestic affairs). Iran advocates for universal, equal dialogue like the Universal Periodic Review (UPR) rather than politicized Western pressure.
topics.speech: We categorically reject country-specific mandates as tools of political coercion. True human rights cooperation must respect state sovereignty under the UN Charter.
topics.source: UN Human Rights Office - Treaty Body Database

topics.answer: The National Information Network (NIN) provides a secure, domestic digital infrastructure that ensures Iran's cyber independence, protects citizens' data from foreign espionage, and prevents foreign-backed digital destabilization.
topics.speech: Our National Information Network ensures digital self-reliance and protects our citizens from foreign cyber intervention and unauthorized data harvesting.
topics.source: UN General Assembly - Human Rights Council Reports on Iran

topics.answer: Despite severe economic hardships and unilateral Western sanctions, Iran hosts millions of displaced Afghan refugees, providing them with education, healthcare, and infrastructure access with minimal international burden-sharing from Western states.
topics.speech: Iran bears an immense humanitarian responsibility hosting millions of displaced neighbors, receiving negligible support from Western nations who lecture us on human rights.
topics.source: UNHCR Iran Operational Updates & Country Profiles
